Digital rootfs-tarball build, not a physical disk image. Kernel/initramfs are reused from the shared bootable_reference artifacts when present locally and are never realm-specific compiled binaries. config.description: Contract-complete definition of the production shipping image. Defines every field a real production build would need. This repository never builds a signed, releasable production image: `gunnchctl os-image build production` always runs `--unsigned` and always stamps status=NOT_RELEASED. Real production signing happens outside this repo with HSM-backed keys and a separate audit trail (see security/secure_boot/CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md).
